queries_run: MP Materials antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR regulatory scrutiny 2026

findings.claim: 10-K風險因素指出，因DoW交易協議，公司可能面臨更嚴格審查、政府稽核／調查、國會關注及司法部執法（含False Claims Act）等；未見反壟斷調查之陳述。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The Company may be subject to heightened scrutiny of our business activities with both government and non-government customers, government audits, investigations, congressional scrutiny, inquiries about conflicts of interest, civil or criminal enforcement by the Department of Justice (including actions under the False Claims Act)

findings.claim: 2026年搜尋未見針對MP的DOJ／FTC／EU反壟斷調查或拆分報導；所見爭議為對USA Rare Earth的營業秘密訴訟，屬非競爭法案件。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果摘要（pulse.bot: MP Materials Accuses USA Rare Earth of Magnet Tech Theft）
findings.excerpt: MP alleges that a former employee handed over its proprietary "grain boundary diffusion" formulations to USA Rare Earth

regulatory_antitrust.note: 只做1次搜尋；第二條as_of為推估日期。
